lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the pectoral fin, arranged in a structured 2D grid with approximately 4-5 visible spots per vertical column in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal alignments of circular blobs, creating distinct anchor nodes within a grid-like pattern across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient featuring a light-colored upper edge and a shadowed lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density distribution of smaller, less ordered high-luminance spots compared to the structured grid of the lateral flank.
